function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Reconstruct the Wirecard and Jan Marsalek public-fraud trail using only evidence available from the benchmark tools. Return a structured evidence inventory, not a narrative based on outside knowledge. Cover: (1) Wirecard public company statements, disclosures, and representations; (2) audit findings, qualifications, limitations, caveats, and uncertainty; (3) reported or alleged missing cash, trustee accounts, and related money or documentation issues; (4) regulatory, supervisory, governmental, political, media, and institutional actions, failures, disputed assessments, or investigations; and (5) Jan Marsalek’s disappearance and any tool-supported connections to the broader case. For every factual item, provide the exact source ID returned by the tools, and where available the exact entity IDs and relationship IDs/names returned by the tools. Classify each item as verified fact, allegation, interpretation, assessment, or unresolved uncertainty. Distinguish what a source says from what can safely be concluded. Do not invent facts, entities, links, dates, causal relationships, or source identifiers; omit unsupported material. Explicitly identify contradictions between sources and avoid treating allegations or later assessments as established facts."}
function.name: ConductResearch
